title: Bead in a viscoelastic gel: microrheology drag and moduli vs frequency (frequency response, mixed u-p, analytic)
description:
Passive / active microrheology geometry, the viscoelastic counterpart of bead_drag_water_frequency_response: a rigid polystyrene bead of radius a = 1 um (rho_b 1050 kg/m^3) held by prescribed_displacement_domain 'bead' and moved along the axis by X = 1 nm in an incompressible gel (no bulk modulus: formulation mixed, Taylor-Hood P2 / P1), axisymmetric (r, z), m = 0, bead centre on the axis at z = R_c in the container r < R_c, 0 < z < 2 R_c with fixed walls (x_lo is the axis), R_c = 32 mm. Gel (exp(+j w t)): G*(w) = G0 + j w mu_s + G1 j w tau1 / (1 + j w tau1), G0 = 10 Pa (relaxed plateau), one Prony branch G1 = 100 Pa, tau1 = 1 / (2 pi 100 Hz) = 1.59 ms, solvent viscosity mu_s = 1e-3 Pa s, rho = 1000 kg/m^3. frequency_response at 22 log-spaced frequencies, 0.1 Hz to 1 MHz (3 per decade; table row r is f = 0.1 Hz x 10^(r/3)): elastic plateau G' = G0 below ~10 Hz (row 6), the relaxation around 100 Hz (row 9: G' 60 Pa, G'' peak 50.6 Pa), the glassy plateau G' = G0 + G1 = 110 Pa with little loss at 1-5 kHz, viscous above G1 / (2 pi mu_s) = 16 kHz, up to a / delta = 1.77 at 1 MHz.
Analytic (correspondence principle): the linearised momentum -rho w^2 u = -grad p + G* lap u with div u = 0 is the unsteady Stokes problem of the velocity j w u with mu -> G* / (j w), so Stokes' drag (Landau-Lifshitz section 24, see the water example) becomes the force of the gel on the bead F = -6 pi a G* X (1 + lam a + lam^2 a^2 / 9), lam = j w sqrt(rho / G*) (principal root: Re lam > 0, the outgoing decaying shear wave, as G* lies in the upper half plane); expanded, -F = 6 pi a X (G* + j w a sqrt(rho G*)) - w^2 m_add X with m_add = (2/3) pi a^3 rho (half the displaced gel). The reaction table of 'bead' is the support force, which also accelerates the bead: F_y = -F - w^2 m_b X, m_b = rho_b 4/3 pi a^3. Checked independently of the FEM (scratch script): G* = j w mu gives the water formula to 1e-16; w -> 0 gives Kelvin's 6 pi G0 a X of an incompressible solid (-F / (6 pi G0 a X) = 1 + 1e-5 at 0.1 Hz); the l = 1 field u = curl curl (f e_z), f = A / r + b exp(-lam r) / r (u = U on r = a), p = G* lam^2 A z / r^3 solves momentum and continuity by 4th-order finite differences (relative residual 3e-9 at 1 MHz to 6e-4 at 100 Hz, limited by the cancellation in f at small |lam a|) and its traction integrated over r = a gives F to 2e-11 (2e-9 at 100 Hz).
Microrheology (generalized Stokes-Einstein relation): the plain GSER reads G_GSER = -F / (6 pi a X) = G* + j w a sqrt(rho G*) - w^2 rho a^2 / 9 as the modulus. Its relative error is ~|lam a| = w a sqrt(rho / |G*|): 2e-3 at 100 Hz, 2 % at 1 kHz (shear-wave radiation on the glassy plateau adds to G''), 18 % at 10 kHz; G'_GSER drops to 0.07 G' at 46 kHz and is negative above (boundary layer and added mass read as negative storage: -2.3 G' at 100 kHz, -139 G' at 1 MHz, where the error is 3 |G*|). The inertia-corrected inversion is exact: with Z = (F_y + w^2 m_b X) / (6 pi a X) and b = w a sqrt(rho), G* = Z - 7 b^2 / 18 - (j b / 2) sqrt(4 Z - 5 b^2 / 9) (the root of the quadratic in sqrt(G*) on the passive branch; verified to 1e-12 at every frequency).
Container: in a weakly damped elastic gel the shear wave reaches the walls and at the plateau the static wall correction is O(a / R_c), so R_c = 32000 a. Container study (same mesh rule, R_c = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 mm): the static deviation Re(F_fem / F) - 1 = 2.17e-3, 1.10e-3, 5.7e-4, 3.1e-4, 1.7e-4, 1.1e-4 = 2.14 a / R_c + 3e-5 (Haberman-Sayre's 2.10 a / R of an infinite cylinder plus the end walls), so 7e-5 here. Below ~5 Hz the shear wave (wavelength 100 mm at 1 Hz) spans the container nearly undamped: the radiation term lam a of the unbounded formula (6e-6 at 0.1 Hz to 6e-5 at 1 Hz, mostly imaginary) is replaced by the cavity response, an Im deviation up to 6e-5 at 1-2 Hz that no container size removes (-6.3e-6 = -|lam a| at 0.1 Hz for every R_c). Above, Re(lam) R_c > 1 and the walls are exponentially far (in the viscous regime delta < 1 um).
Mesh: h = 0.12 um in the bead (delta(1 MHz) / 4.7), growth 1.25, h_max = R_c / 4, h_min = 0.06 um (the default dx / 100 = 80 um would leave the bead without elements), ~4,300 triangles; ~5 s on the CPU, 280 MB.
Curves & tables tab: the bead reaction F_y_re, F_y_im versus frequency with their analytic curves; derived curves per table row: drag_deviation (Re and Im of F_fem / F_analytic - 1, over 0), moduli (log scale: G' and G'' recovered by the inertia-corrected inversion over the input G*(f), and the plain GSER G', G''; the plain G' leaves the log axis at row 17 where it turns negative) and modulus_error (|G - G*| / |G*| of both inversions). Derived values tab: the Kelvin ratio at 0.1 Hz, the inertia-corrected loss modulus at the relaxation (100 Hz, 50.63 Pa) and |F_fem / F_analytic| at 1 MHz. Field tab: u_abs and the pressure at 1 MHz (zoom to the bead).
Measured agreement (tolerances in brackets): drag deviation Re 1.1e-4 (4e-4) at the static end (wall 7e-5 + grading 3e-5) and Im 1.4e-4 (4e-4) at 1 kHz, where the 330 um shear wave is resolved by ~4 P2 elements in the graded zone; 2.7e-5 at 1 MHz (1e-4); F_y_re / F_y_im curves 1.9e-5 / 2.4e-5 of their range (1e-4); modulus_error inertia-corrected 1.6e-4 (5e-4); G' recovered 1.2e-3 of its range (4e-3: at 1 MHz G' is 1.7 % of |G*|, so the drag error is amplified ~|G*| / G'), G'' recovered 4.4e-5 (2e-4); Kelvin ratio 1.1e-4 (4e-4), loss modulus at 100 Hz 4.1e-5 (2e-4). Refinement: h in the bead halved gives 1.4e-5 at 1 MHz; growth 1.15 gives 1-2e-5 above 5 Hz (1 kHz: 2e-5, so the mid-band error is the wave resolution of the grading) and 7.7e-5 at the static end (the wall's 7e-5): what is left is discretisation, the O(a / R_c) wall and the missing radiation term below 5 Hz.

parameters.name: X_b
parameters.description: prescribed axial displacement amplitude of the bead [m]

parameters.name: G_0
parameters.description: relaxed (plateau) shear modulus of the gel [Pa]

parameters.name: G_1
parameters.description: shear modulus of the Maxwell (Prony) branch [Pa]

parameters.name: f_rel
parameters.description: relaxation frequency 1 / (2 pi tau_1) of the branch [Hz]

parameters.name: R_c
parameters.description: container radius and half height (static wall correction 2.14 a / R_c = 7e-5)

parameters.name: h_bead
parameters.description: triangle size inside the bead (delta(1 MHz) / 4.7)

parameters.name: m_add
parameters.description: added mass, half the displaced gel [kg]

parameters.name: n_dec
parameters.description: frequencies per decade (table row r is f_lo*10**(r/n_dec))
